aliases: Role and requirements of TVET teachers
banglaExplanation: Teacher শুধু পড়ান না, learner-কে পুরো শেখার পথে সহায়তা করেন।
Learner কেন training নিচ্ছে জানা, learning plan করতে সাহায্য করা, qualification pathways বোঝানো।
যোগাযোগ রাখা, effective feedback দেওয়া, motivate করা।

example.bn: Trainer phone নম্বর দেন, নিয়মিত learners-এর খোঁজ রাখেন।
example.en: An IT trainer tells learners his phone number and office hours. He checks on absent learners every week.

short.modelAnswer:
A teacher's role in supporting the learner is vital. To support learners, a teacher will need to:
1. Know a little about the learner and why they are training
2. Help learners plan their learning
3. Describe qualification pathways
4. Give effective feedback
5. Motivate learners to keep them going

realQuestions.answer:
As a teacher and/or assessor in TVET sector, one's role in supporting the learner
is vital. To be able to support learners, a teacher will need to:
•
know a little about the learner, including why they are doing the training
and/or assessment
•
help learners plan their learning
•
describe qualification pathways
•
take the initiative to generate and encourage communication
•
advise learners of your availability for contact, including any limits and
•
how you can be contacted, for example, by phone or email
•
keep in touch with learners
•
help learners monitor their own learning
•
link learning to learners' experience
•
give effective feedback
•
motivate learners to keep them going
•
encourage learners to learn from each other
